run_metadata.promptContent: We need a full analytics pipeline. There are 40 product interaction events in `/data/events/` as JSON files. ClickHouse and Redpanda are installed but not running. Use the Moose project at `/workspace/moose-project` to set everything up so: there's an HTTP endpoint that accepts new events in real-time, events flow through a Redpanda topic as a buffer, data lands in ClickHouse, there are pre-aggregated tables for dashboards, and three egress endpoints return top products, a conversion funnel, and hourly activity. Load the 40 seed events through your ingestion endpoint. All egress endpoints should respond under 200ms.
